summary: Triage open support tickets by normalizing inputs, deduplicating updates by retaining the latest occurrence, filtering out closed tickets, ordering open tickets by severity with alphanumeric tie-breaking, and summarizing ticket counts and affected customers.

requirements.description: Tickets with repeated IDs represent updates where only the last occurrence is retained, and tickets whose latest state is closed are excluded from the open triage summary.

sources.quote: Repeated IDs are updates: keep the last occurrence, and exclude tickets whose latest state is closed.

acceptance.given: A list of tickets containing multiple updates with identical IDs and various states
acceptance.then: Only the latest entry for each ID is evaluated, and tickets whose latest state is closed are excluded from the triage queue and counts

requirements.description: Urgent open tickets must appear before normal and low tickets in the queue, with ties within the same severity resolved in ascending ticket ID order.

sources.quote: Urgent open tickets must appear before normal and low tickets; ties should use the ticket ID in ascending order.

acceptance.given: A set of open tickets with urgent, normal, and low severities
acceptance.then: The queue orders tickets urgent then normal then low, breaking ties using ticket ID in ascending order

requirements.description: The triage summary counts open tickets by severity (urgent, normal, low) and lists each affected customer ID once in ascending order.

sources.quote: The summary must count open tickets by severity and list each affected customer once in ascending ID order.

acceptance.given: A set of open tickets associated with customer IDs and severities
acceptance.then: bySeverity contains counts for urgent, normal, and low tickets, and customerIds lists unique affected customer IDs sorted in ascending order

assumptions: Ticket objects must provide id, title, customerId, severity, and state string properties.
String fields must be trimmed, and severity and state values are normalized to lowercase.
Valid severity values are urgent, normal, and low; valid state values are open and closed.
Non-array inputs to summarizeTickets and malformed tickets throw a TypeError.
Inputs are treated as immutable and must not be modified.
